title: Rest in the nearness already given
summary: Let held nearness become more believable than private force. Let this stay near the next choice: carry this with you: let grace make the Lord near enough to stop the chase.
takeaway: Return the heart to shelter before it hardens again.
lifeApplication: When the urge to hold yourself up alone returns, say the line like a child asking to be kept and let one breath soften.

source.shortMeaning: Grace makes the Lord intimate, and restless searching begins to end.
source.lifeApplication: When tired seeking returns, pause and remember the One you are chasing is near.
